indicator.subject: Mathematics
indicator.content_standard: B4.3.3.1 Demonstrate understanding of perimeter of regular and irregular shapes
indicator.objective: Develop and apply a formula for determining perimeter of square and rectangle

skills.description: Calculate the perimeter of a square using the formula P = 4s.
Calculate the perimeter of a rectangle using the formula P = 2(l + w).
Solve real-world problems involving the perimeter of squares and rectangles.

spec.difficultyPlan: 20 questions: 5 at difficulty 1, 7 at difficulty 2, 5 at difficulty 3, 3 at difficulty 4.
misconceptions: Adding only length and width (missing two sides).
Using the area formula (l x w) instead of the perimeter formula.

questions.stem: What is the formula for the perimeter of a square?
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a square is 4 times the side length (P = 4s).
questions.misconception: Confusing with the area formula (s x s).

questions.stem: A square has a side length of 6 cm. What is its perimeter?
What is the formula for the perimeter of a rectangle?
hints: A rectangle has 2 lengths and 2 widths.
questions.explanation: The perimeter of a rectangle is 2(length + width).
questions.misconception: Confusing with the area formula (l x w).

questions.stem: A rectangle has a length of 8 cm and a width of 3 cm. What is its perimeter?
A square has a perimeter of 20 cm. What is the length of one side?
A rectangle has a length of 12 m and a width of 5 m. What is the perimeter?
What is the perimeter of a square with sides of 9 cm?
A farmer wants to build a fence around a rectangular garden that is 10 m long and 4 m wide. How many metres of fencing does he need?
A rectangular table has a perimeter of 24 cm. Its length is 8 cm. What is its width?
A square has a perimeter of 32 cm. What is the side length?
A picture frame is a square with a side length of 15 cm. What is the perimeter of the frame?
Explain the difference between the area and the perimeter of a rectangle.
questions.explanation: Perimeter is the total distance around the outside of the rectangle, while area is the amount of space inside it.
questions.misconception: Thinking they are the same thing.

questions.stem: A rectangular football pitch is 100 m long and 60 m wide. A player runs around the perimeter once. How far does the player run?
A square and a rectangle have the same perimeter. The square has sides of 6 cm. The rectangle has a length of 7 cm. What is the width of the rectangle?
questions.misconception: Assuming the widths are the same.

questions.stem: A rectangular garden is 15 m by 8 m. A fence is built around it. If fencing costs 10 cedis per metre, what is the total cost?
A pupil calculates the perimeter of a 5 cm by 3 cm rectangle as 5 + 3 = 8 cm. What mistake did they make?
hints: Did they include all four sides?
questions.explanation: The pupil only added one length and one width. They need to add all four sides: 5 + 3 + 5 + 3 = 16 cm.

criteria.description: Identifies that all 4 sides were not added.

questions.misconception: Thinking only two sides make a perimeter.

questions.stem: A piece of wire is 48 cm long. It is bent to form a square. What is the length of one side of the square?
questions.misconception: Bending the wire to form a rectangle with different dimensions.

questions.stem: A rectangular room is 6 m long and 4 m wide. A border is to be placed along the edge of the ceiling. If the border costs 5 cedis per metre, how much will it cost?
A farmer has 36 m of fencing. He wants to enclose a square plot. What is the length of one side?
